Discussed Diwali and Pongal as festivals across India.
Identified Pongal as involving rice cooked with milk and sugar.
Practised linking harvest festivals with the season when crops are ready.
Kavya continued to describe festival dates as random and did not pass the teach-back.
end.parentNote: Today, Asha practised how Pongal is connected to farming, harvested crops, and the season when crops are ready. Kavya recalled the rice dish made with milk and sugar and shared details about Diwali. The idea that harvest-festival dates are random was still present at the end. At home, use a simple calendar to mark Pongal and talk about which crops are ready around that time.
